definition_used: The corresponding author(s) did not respond to journal/publisher requests for response, clarification, etc., about one or more concerns/issues with a publication. RW does not apply this reason when the lack of response is only to the language or posting of a notice of correction/EOC/retraction.ion after prior contact by Journal, Publisher or other original Authors
caution: The reason describes a procedural failure (non-response) rather than a direct content or integrity issue. It is a status/transparency signal, not a primary cause of retraction. Main figure recommendation is false because the category is only broadly supported and the reason is secondary to underlying concerns.
semantic_rationale: Author unresponsiveness impedes post-publication clarification and due process, fitting the oversight category broadly. It does not directly indicate content unreliability, authorship issues, or editorial governance failures.
